# `missing-resource-cleanup`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a recognized resource or mutex with no visible cleanup, unlock, or
ownership transfer.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

File handles, clients, containers, and locks often retain memory or system state
even when no raw allocation is visible.

## When it fires

It applies to known constructor/cleanup pairs and lock scopes, including error
paths that leave a mutex locked. Cleanup of every resource-owning aggregate
field satisfies the contract; custom ownership conventions require explicit
project policy or code.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn save(directory: anytype) !void {
    const file = try directory.openFile("state", .{});
    try file.writeAll("ready");
}
```
